The product itself was fine quality-wise, but the return process was incredibly misleading and frustrating.

The website prominently advertised “30-day risk-free returns,” which gave the impression of a normal, easy return process. After receiving the Apple Watch band, I realized it did not fit my wrist properly and contacted customer service promptly to initiate a return.

Instead of simply processing the return, I went through approximately 14 back-and-forth emails where the company repeatedly attempted to avoid the return by first offering a replacement product and then offering a partial refund if I kept the item.

Only after repeatedly insisting on returning the product according to the advertised policy was I informed that returns had to be shipped internationally to China. This was not clearly disclosed on the website before purchase, nor was it obvious that this was an overseas retailer. I was then expected to coordinate and initially pay for tracked international shipping myself and wait for reimbursement later.

That is not what most consumers would reasonably expect from a “risk-free return” policy.

Customer service did eventually agree in writing to reimburse shipping costs and issue a refund after receipt, which is why I am not calling this a scam but I do not trust that I'd get reimbursed if I sent the product back to the random address they sent me in China. The overall process was extremely time-consuming, misleading, and far more burdensome than the website suggests before checkout.

Buyers should be aware that returning products may involve extensive back-and-forth communication and international return shipping to China.

I ordered an Apple Watch wristband from this website (200€). Delivery took around two weeks, which was acceptable, and the quality of the product itself was actually quite decent. However, the size was not what I expected, so I decided to return it. I contacted customer service by email, and at first they replied quite quickly. They tried to solve the issue by offering me another product or asking me to choose something different. But after I insisted on returning the item, communication slowed down. A few days later, I finally received a return address in China.
There was no return barcode, no prepaid label, and no proper return process — I was expected to ship it back myself and pay the postage. I noticed that other customers here mentioned the same issue: once you send the product back, the return is apparently never confirmed, and you may never receive your refund.

So, in my opinion, buying from this website feels like a one-way ticket, even though they mention 30-Days return policy. If you are satisfied with the product, maybe everything is fine. But if you need to return something, it becomes very difficult and risky.

I agree with other reviews mentioning poor tracking information, fast initial customer service, and a very problematic refund process. In the end, I will probably just keep the product rather than risk paying more for return shipping and possibly never seeing my money again.
